title: GGP-01 Modular Helmet HUD

source_sheet.notes: Supersedes v1. Fabricated Bloom telemetry is presented exactly like genuine Bloom telemetry and contains no player-visible truth leak.

concept_sources.role: visor frame and safe visual opening
Bloom warning and psychosis presentation source

value.violet: active scan or anomaly mode, never false-signal disclosure

approved.value: body and suit telemetry, restrained aiming reference, interaction context, and urgent warnings
genuine and fabricated Bloom telemetry use the same widget, severity mapping, copy, color, icon, animation, audio cue, and dismissal behavior
approved.note: Only private gameplay state may know whether the reading is fabricated. Presentation receives no truth flag.

conflicts.description: The visual concept includes pressure and CO2 widgets that are not direct named setters in USurvivalHUDWidget.
conflicts.resolution: Bind them through the authoritative atmosphere or status snapshot rather than creating HUD-owned simulation values.

pivot.name: ANCHOR_Viewport
pivot.rule: All persistent widgets anchor inside the visor-safe area; center reticle remains viewport-centered.

blender.note: No Blender geometry required; visor-frame texture remains a supporting raster asset.

unreal.import_policy: Implement as replaceable UMG components backed by existing native HUD setters. Simulation state remains gameplay-owned, and the widget must never receive a false-versus-genuine truth flag.

acceptance_checks.requirement: Every visible widget maps to an authoritative gameplay field or explicit presentation-only state.
All critical information remains readable across supported aspect ratios and platform safe areas.
Scale, opacity, captions, reduced motion, and color-independent warning shapes work without clipping.
Persistent UI does not obscure traversal, interaction targets, or threat silhouettes.
A blinded comparison of genuine and fabricated Bloom warnings reveals no difference in widget, severity, copy, color, icon, animation, audio cue, timing, or dismissal behavior.
False-versus-genuine source truth remains player-private and is never passed into presentation code or replicated to other players.
Native USurvivalHUDWidget and Blueprint presentation survive baseline, warning, critical, death, respawn, and run-outcome flows.

build_questions: Which atmosphere snapshot supplies pressure and CO2 to the visor?
Which HUD components must support ultrawide repositioning rather than uniform scaling?
How will automated tests prove identical genuine and fabricated Bloom presentation without exposing source truth to the widget?
